Problem

Kya inme se koi problem aapke saath bhi ho rahi hai?

Ye wo problems hain jo har roz chhote aur medium businesses ka paisa aur time le jaati hain.

1
Enquiry aayi, reply kal kiyaTab tak customer competitor se baat kar chuka hota hai.
2
Leads aati hain, convert nahi hotiEk message, phir follow-up band. Lead thandi pad jaati hai.
3
Ads pe paisa jalta hai, sale nahiClicks aur leads dikhte hain, par bank mein paisa nahi aata.
4
Social media pe consistency nahiTeen din post, phir do hafte gayab. Reach aur trust dono girte hain.
5
Video banana mehenga aur slowShoot, studio, editor. Budget nahi toh video nahi.
6
Brand ki koi pehchaan nahiCustomer aapko yaad nahi rakhta, sirf price compare karta hai.
7
Leads ka koi record nahiKuch WhatsApp mein, kuch diary mein. Jo dikhta nahi, uska follow-up nahi.
8
Deadlines miss, blame aap parTeam ka kaam groups aur Excel mein kho jaata hai.
9
Agency bolti hai "chal raha hai"Har mahine paisa jaata hai, par results ka koi hisaab nahi.

Agar aap bhi in problems se guzar rahe ho, toh hamare paas iska system hai.

FAQ

Aapke sawaal, hamare jawab

VishAI.biz kya karta hai?

Hum small aur medium businesses ke liye 4 AI systems banate hain: AI Lead Nurturing, AI Social Media Marketing, AI Video Marketing aur AI Project Management. Sab ek team aur ek dashboard se.

Kya ye sirf bade businesses ke liye hai?

Nahi. Ye khaas taur pe small aur medium businesses (MSMEs) ke liye bana hai, jinke paas badi marketing team nahi hai.

Kya main ek service se shuru kar sakta hoon?

Haan. Zyada tar clients ek system se shuru karte hain, jaise lead follow-up, aur results dekh ke baaki jodte hain.

Kitna kharcha hoga?

Ye aapke business aur chuni hui service pe depend karta hai. Free strategy call mein aapki zaroorat samajh ke clear quote dete hain, koi chhupa kharcha nahi.

Results kab dikhenge?

Setup 2-3 hafte mein live hota hai, aur pehli weekly report Week 4 mein aati hai. Growth aapke market aur budget pe depend karti hai, isliye hum har hafte numbers dikhate hain.

Mujhe kitna time dena hoga?

Shuru mein ek strategy call aur kuch details (logo, photos, products). Uske baad hafte mein sirf approvals aur ek short review.

Founding Client Program kya hai?

Hamare pehle clients ke liye ek limited program, jisme founder ke saath direct kaam, priority onboarding aur custom AI growth plan milta hai.
